maria: Quick sync — I'm kicking off telemetry for the adaptive tokenflow batcher (continuous-batching heuristic tuning). Need a minimal set of panels/metrics to validate token budget targets, queue policy effects, and kernel-selection impacts. Who's around for a short checklist?

kevin: 👍 add per-batch kernel tag + KV cache hit rate. Also want avg_tokens_per_batch and token_throughput (tokens/sec) broken down by model and queue_policy label.

olivia: I sketched a first-pass Grafana layout. Panels: heatmap(batch_size over time), timeseries(token/sec), stacked area(kernel_selector_fraction), table of recent perf-regressions. Prototype queries below — will iterate.

olivia: ```
# approx PromQL examples
rate(batcher_tokens_emitted_total[1m]) as token_sec
sum by (model,queue_policy,ker_sel) (rate(batcher_tokens_emitted_total[5m]))
(batcher_tokens_emitted_total{ker_sel="int8"} / batcher_tokens_emitted_total) * 100
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy completed: adaptive-batcher v3.2 -> namespace=canary (commit: 9f3a7c) :rocket:

maria: Proposed metric list (minimal):
- batch_utilization (tokens_emitted / token_budget_target)
- avg_queue_depth (p50/p95)
- token_throughput (tokens/sec) by model
- tokens_per_batch distribution (heatmap)
- kv_cache_hit_rate (sampled)
- kernel_selector_fraction (enum: float32,int8,fp16,auto)
- kernel_fallback_events counter (label: reason)
- token_budget_truncations counter (per-customer sample)
Also: capture span samples for requests that see >20ms extra latency when joining a batch.

kevin: Strong +1. Also: tag metrics with `queue_policy` (fifo|aging|priority) and `batch_priority` (low|normal|high) to analyze policy effects. Please keep cardinality tight (enums only).

maria: Note on sampling: high-cardinality metrics (per-customer token_budget_truncations) should be sampled at 0.5-1% with full traces captured on sample. We'll add a `sampled_trace_id` label when present.

olivia: For detection rules: regression alert when p50 token_throughput drops >15% vs 1h baseline AND kernel_selector_fraction shifts >20% toward fallback. Alert snippet: 
```
WHEN (p50(token_throughput[5m]) < 0.85 * avg_over_time(p50(token_throughput[1h])[1h])) AND (increase(kernel_fallback_events[30m]) > 0)
```

kevin: Also correlate with KV cache cold-starts: include `kv_eviction_events` and `kv_miss_rate` panels. If kv_miss_rate spikes with lower batch utilization, that could explain perf regressions.

maria: Dashboard panels I'll add this afternoon:
- left: timeseries token/sec (per-model small multiples)
- middle: heatmap tokens_per_batch (1h window)
- right-top: stacked kernel usage fraction (5m)
- right-bottom: kv_hit_rate + eviction table (latest 100 events)
- bottom: recent traces table linking to Jaeger (filter: batch_size>8 or latency_regression=true)

sre: FYI alert fired earlier (17:23 UTC): `batcher_queue_depth_p95{model="redwood-base"}` = 512 for ~12m. No errors but visible latency tail.

maria: Thanks — can you paste the alert window logs? want to correlate with kernel_fallback_events.

sre: pasted: `2026-03-16T17:22:58Z batcher_queue_depth=512 model=redwood-base zone=us-west2 duration=720s`

kevin: Suggest adding a small panel that shows `latency_vs_batch_size` scatter (sampled) — helps spot sweet spot where adding tokens to a batch increases p95. We should measure per-kernel too.

olivia: Agree. I'll add an aggregate scatter sampling 1% of requests, color by kernel. Query will point to a dashboard link once created.

maria: Operational notes: keep aggregation windows conservative (1m/5m) for token/sec. For alerts use 5m window to avoid noisy flaps. We'll run a 24h canary comparing queue_policy=fifo vs queue_policy=aging with the same workload and use these metrics to pick defaults.

kevin: One more: expose `pending_token_budget` gauge per routing-group (low-card) so we can see throttling backlog.

maria: Good call. I'll add that gauge and a small table showing top groups by pending_token_budget.

olivia: Pushing prototype dashboard -> https://grafana.internal/r/adaptive-tokenflow-proto (permissions: eng-runtime + obs). Will update with queries + panels.

maria: Perfect. Next steps: kevin to add kernel selection tags + events in runtime, olivia to push dashboard, sre to share alert logs and timeline, i'll coordinate canary comparison and sampling config. Back here in ~2h for quick check. :white_check_mark:
